# Magic Editor X

> Strapi 5 plugin (npm: magic-editor-x, plugin id: magic-editor-x, MIT) that adds an Editor.js custom field `plugin::magic-editor-x.richtext` with Media Library uploads, custom blocks, version history, live collaboration across several Node processes and an optional AI assistant that uses the owner's provider (Anthropic, OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible server).

Key facts for code generation:

- The field stores an Editor.js object `{ time, blocks: [{ id, type, data, tunes? }], version }`. Entries saved with 1.x may hold a JSON string until saved again; the Content API parses it when `api.autoParseJSON` is on (default).
- Block names: paragraph, header, list, checklist, quote, warning, alert, toggle, code, codeFlask, delimiter, table, embed, raw, image, simpleImage, linkTool, attaches, personality, button, plus custom block names. Tunes: alignmentTune, textVariant, indentTune. The README lists the `data` of each block.
- Values are normalised and sanitised on every Document Service write; invalid or oversized values (over 5 MiB, 5000 blocks or depth 24) answer 400.
- Inline HTML may contain b, strong, i, em, u, s, mark, code, a, br, span (cdx-tooltip), sub, sup. Escape plain-text fields when rendering.
- Admin routes only, under `/magic-editor-x`, each gated by `admin::hasPermissions` with `plugin::magic-editor-x.access|collaborate|ai.use|custom-blocks.manage|settings.read|settings.update`. Version history and collaboration also check Content Manager read/update permissions per document, locale and field; denied answers 404.
- Collaboration: `POST /magic-editor-x/collaboration/session` returns a one-time signed token; Socket.IO on `collaboration.path` with the WebSocket transport only; handshake `auth: { token, protocol: 3 }`; events `mx:welcome`, `mx:sync`, `mx:update`, `mx:resync`, `mx:presence`, `mx:cursor`, `mx:role`, `mx:error`. Block data is structured in Yjs (schema 3: maps, arrays, texts per field), so concurrent edits of different cells, items, tunes and fields merge. Works without sticky sessions; all processes share the database and `ADMIN_JWT_SECRET`.
- AI: `POST /magic-editor-x/ai/:action` with `{ text, language?, tone? }`; actions improve, grammar, shorten, expand, summarize, simplify, translate, tone, continue. The key never reaches the browser.
